tasks.claim: Mechanism ablation one: fixed-core address organization. Explicit public mapping replay through operator benchmarks; kernel launch-sequence timing. Not full C API end-to-end timing, automatic search, or the complete core-transfer ablation.

tasks.required_interface: Public search accepts immutable component exclusions and fixed arithmetic core identity; enumerate/filter every candidate before measurement, preserve equal candidate/timing budget and independent selected replay. Existing PlanOptions mapping is explicit replay, not a constraint on adaptive search.
tasks.claim: No component-disabled search is queued until the runtime enforces the contract. Manually comparing explicit mappings cannot stand in for re-search.

tasks.required_interface: Expose verifiable leaf/subgraph arithmetic and coefficient identities in conventional parallel and mixed organizations. FWHT/zeta/structured shared-iterative admits only scalar radix2; radix4/8 elsewhere are equivalent implementations with changed local grouping, not demonstrated portable second leaves. NTT has multiple generic subgraph cores but no matched conventional-vs-mixed fixed-leaf contract with constrained search. FFT standalone leaves already work; public factor-overlap and black-box external libraries do not fill this gap.
tasks.claim: Retain missing cells per operator; full external libraries remain external baselines. This task is not satisfied by the layout task or by candidate count.
